decisions.reason: As a close-to-core launch with its own product page in a growing industry, it appears to meet at least provisional aspirations and is worth retaining while the firm learns more about demand.

This serum fits the firm’s established skincare capabilities and customer base, and with no clear sign of underperformance a small incumbent would usually keep such a recent product rather than reallocate resources immediately.

The cleansing milk is adjacent to the existing offer and likely uses familiar ingredients, production, and sales channels, so under behavioral decision-making the firm would continue it until stronger evidence of a shortfall emerges.
